arguments.question: Using registered split-adjusted daily price series for ANET, QQQ, MU, META, NVDA and fixed SPY/XLK/XLC/IWM/HYG comparators, assess 21/63-session trend, relative performance, drawdown/volatility and technically meaningful review levels. Distinguish observed calculations from inference and do not imply executable trade levels. Stopping criterion: use only the registered price series and report missing history/indicator limitations.
arguments.decision_impact: Could determine whether a fundamental or macro thesis has confirming versus conflicting price/relative-strength evidence, and establish non-executable review conditions.
